segments.sn45.27:1.2: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, kumbho anādhāro suppavattiyo hoti, sādhāro duppavattiyo hoti;
segments.sn45.27:1.3: evameva kho, bhikkhave, cittaṃ anādhāraṃ suppavattiyaṃ hoti, sādhāraṃ duppavattiyaṃ hoti.
segments.sn45.27:1.5: Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi … pe … sammāsamādhi.
segments.sn45.27:1.8: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, kumbho anādhāro suppavattiyo hoti, sādhāro duppavattiyo hoti;
segments.sn45.27:1.9: evameva kho, bhikkhave, cittaṃ anādhāraṃ suppavattiyaṃ hoti, sādhāraṃ duppavattiyaṃ hotī”ti.

lines: Imesu tatiyādīsu catūsu suttesu vaṭṭavivaṭṭaṃ kathitaṃ, pacchimesu panettha dvīsu puggalo pucchito dhammo vibhatto, evaṃ dhammena puggalo dassitoti.
Yathā icchiticchitaṃ disaṃ pavattento dhāvati, evaṃ pavattetuṃ sakkā hotīti attho.
So eva taṃsamaṅgīnaṃ vaṭṭadukkhapātato dhāraṇaṭṭhena dhammoti āha –
Ñāṇassa micchāsabhāvo nāma natthīti viññāṇamevettha paccavekkhaṇavasena pavattaṃ ñāṇa-saddena vuccatīti āha “micchāviññāṇo”ti.
Micchāpaccavekkhaṇoti kiñci pāpaṃ katvā “aho mayā kataṃ sukatan”ti evaṃ pavatto micchāpaccavekkhaṇo.
Puggalo pucchitoti nigamito ca “ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asappuriso”tiādinā.
Kiñcāpi “micchādiṭṭhiko hotī”tiādinā puggalova niddiṭṭho, tathāpi puggalasīsenāyaṃ dhammadesanāti āha “dhammo vibhatto”ti.
Paccayuppannena upecca nissitabbato upanisā, paccayo, ekassa sa-kārassa lopaṃ katvā vāti āha –
Sahajātavasena upanissayavasena ca sapaccayatā kiccasādhane nipphādane sahāyabhāvūpagamane ca saparivāratā daṭṭhabbā.
